The PO prices match the invoice lines. Now the tax: contract clause KTR-V-034#3.1 sets VAT at 11% of the subtotal. 11% of 5,785,700 = 636,427. The invoice charged 694,284 = 12% of subtotal. So the wrong rate was applied.

Let me confirm no other contractual tax provision exists.
